::: {#exr-dog-stand-plant}
The figure shows three aspects of a dynamical system. Match each to the appropriate color.

a. the flow field `r devoirs::devoirs_set(id = "dsp-a", choices = c("black", "blue", "green"), correct = "black")`
b. a trajectory `r devoirs::devoirs_set(id = "dsp-b", choices = c("black", "blue", "green"), correct = "blue")`
c. a time series `r devoirs::devoirs_set(id = "dsp-c", choices = c("black", "blue", "green"), correct = "green")`

```{r}
#| label: fig-climb-56
#| fig-cap: "Aspects of a dynamical system"
#| echo: false
f <- doodle_fun(~ w + z, seed = 9390)
# contour_plot(f(w, z) ~ w & z, domain(w=-5:5, z = -5:5)) |>
#   gf_refine(coord_fixed())

dfdw <- numD(f(w, z) ~ w)
dfdz <- numD(f(w, z) ~ z)
# Why are these reversed?
climb <- makeODE(dz ~ dfdw(w, z), dw ~ dfdz(w,z),
                 w = -5, z = 3.1)
soln <- suppressMessages(integrateODE(climb, domain(t = 0:10)))
Pts <- tibble::tibble(
  t = seq(0, 10, length = 100),
  z = soln$z(t),
  w = soln$w(t)
)
vectorfield_plot(dz ~ dfdw(w, z), dw ~ dfdz(w,z),  
                 domain(w=-5:5, z = -5:5), 
                 transform = function(x) sqrt(x), 
                 stretch = 1.5) |>
  gf_line(z ~ w, data = Pts, inherit = FALSE, color = "blue") |>
  #contour_plot(f(w, z) ~ w & z, alpha = 0.3) |>
  gf_refine(coord_fixed()) |>
  gf_theme(theme_minimal())

gf_line(z ~ t, data = Pts, color = "darkgreen") |> 
  gf_theme(theme_minimal())
```

Explain what you see in the figure that tells you that the flow field, trajectory, and time series are consistent with one another.

`r devoirs::devoirs_text("dsp-d-3ks")`


:::
